body:
Hi Esther,

Thank you for informing me. I wish you a wonderful journey ahead.

Regarding your question, we maintain and store study data for one year free of charge, but anything further will add 20% per year to the license cost. After the license expires, the study/data may be removed unless a new license is issued or an extension is requested.

I understand you're already in touch with our support team about adding the project's principal investigator to the study. Please let me know if there's anything else I can help with.

Thank you for sharing your personal email address.

If you have any further questions or need assistance with the transition, please feel free to reach out.

Best,
Sara

subject: Change of contact details
body:
Hi Esther,

My pleasure!

I apologize for any confusion. Your data has been stored free of charge during your license's one-year validity period, from October 2, 2023, to October 2, 2024. Starting October 3, 2024, any additional storage will incur a 20% fee.

Please rest assured that we will send 2 or 3 email notifications before removing any data. I have also ensured that your data/study remains intact for now, given your situation. We would appreciate it if you could update the team and let us know if they would like to proceed with the extension.

If you have any further questions or need more clarification, please feel free to reach out.

Best,
Sara
